title: Installments Paid Ahead on a Repeat Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Reinstatement
content:
**Training note — repeat reinstatements, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

A discretionary reinstatement — one the company grants at its discretion, not a reinstatement the state reinstatement period grants — of a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract that was reinstated before pays installments ahead. The number follows the contract's days past due at the last nightly cycle.

| Discretionary reinstatement of a contract that | Days past due at the last nightly cycle | Installments added |
|---|---|---|
| shows an earlier reinstatement payment | 90 or more (the pay-ahead days past due) | two monthly installments |
| shows an earlier reinstatement payment | fewer than 90 | one monthly installment |
| shows no earlier reinstatement payment | any | none |
| — a reinstatement the state period grants | any | none |

**Q. The contract shows one earlier reinstatement payment and is 89 days past due. How many installments are added?** One.

**Q. The same contract at 90 days past due?** Two — 90 is at least the pay-ahead figure.

**Q. Hypothetical monthly payment of $410.00 and two installments added: what is added?** $820.00.
